name: Triggers (custom triggers, voice bridge, settings by voice)
description: The user-facing side of the kernel's triggers@1. TriggerStore keeps custom triggers and per-trigger overrides (enabled, threshold, worksIn) as one trigger-store@1 JSON value in the KV store; permanent triggers come from modules at runtime, can't be deleted and can be switched off only where their module allows it; every change is mirrored into the kernel TriggerRegistry. VoiceTriggerBridge feeds lib-voice VoiceResults through the sensitivity floor and arming into TriggerMatcher with the current context, emits fired TriggerCommands on a flow and hands every decision (per-trigger confidence + outcome) to a plain log callback. SettingsVoiceBindings registers TriggerHosting.bindingTriggers and writes TriggerHosting.settingChange through lib-settings (or the kernel Config), coercing spoken values to the setting's kind. Screens: dense single-column trigger list, add-trigger flow (kind → phrases → action → details), action picker with a pinned search bar filtering live across all tabs, threshold editor.

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-triggers:testDebugUnitTest

placeholders.note: Sync custom triggers + overrides across devices / axHub (TriggerSync; PlaceholderTriggerSync answers NotImplemented).
Hand-gesture detector (kernel placeholder kind); the add flow already lets you pick the kind and type signature ids.
